ITEM 1 | Small whole red grapes, glossy deep red to burgundy skin, smooth and round, about 1.5-2 cm diameter, clustered in a loose group across the upper-left portion of the plate; roughly 25 grapes | 110
ITEM 2 | Whole red grapes, lighter pinkish-red with slightly translucent skin, scattered in the upper-center area among the darker grapes; about 10 grapes | 45
ITEM 3 | Fresh strawberry pieces, bright red flesh with pale white core visible, cut into wedges and halves about 2-3 cm long, glossy and moist, scattered on the right side of the plate; about 4 pieces | 60
ITEM 4 | Watermelon cubes, bright pink-red flesh with a moist, juicy look, cut into roughly 2.5-3 cm chunks, arranged in the lower-right of the plate; about 5 pieces | 85
ITEM 5 | Browned roasted round pieces, golden-brown to dark brown with a slightly caramelized, matte surface and some darker charred spots, about 2-2.5 cm across, scattered in the center and left of the plate; about 5 pieces | 50
ITEM 6 | Single square block of pale off-white firm cube, about 3 cm per side, with a lightly golden, slightly browned edge on one side and a smooth matte surface, sitting at the lower-left of the fruit | 30
